traditional: 邊 + CL + N + V，就 + V
jyutping: bin1 CL N V zau6 V

english.note: Use this pattern when the action or result depends on which option meets a condition.

examples.english: We’ll go into whichever restaurant has a free table.
examples.traditional: 邊間餐廳有位，就入邊間。
examples.jyutping: bin1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jau5 wai2 zau6 jap6 bin1 gaan1
